privacyPolicy.title: Privacy policy
privacyPolicy.intro: How Parcolia protects the data of rental agencies and their clients, in line with Moroccan law 09-08 on the protection of individuals with regard to the processing of personal data.

who.title: Who is responsible?
who.body:
Each agency is responsible for its clients' data (it collects it to rent its cars). Parcolia is its processor: we host and process this data only to run the app, on the agency's instructions.
Contact: {contact}

data.title: Which data?
data.body:
Accounts: name, email, phone of the agency's members.
Agencies' clients: identity, ID card or passport, licence, contact details, address, rentals, payments.
Cars: plate, papers, mileage, maintenance.
Technical log: actions made in the app (who, what, when), without the content of conversations with the assistant.

why.title: Why?
why.body: Manage bookings and rental contracts, find who drove a car (fines, accidents), follow maintenance and insurance, keep the agency's accounts, send the alerts the agency asked for.

ai.title: AI assistant
ai.body: When a member asks the assistant a question, or runs the inspection « AI comparison », the data needed (the agency's data for the question; reduced copies of the car photos for the inspection) is sent to the AI service (Groq, or Anthropic depending on the setup) for the time of the answer. It is not used to train models and Parcolia keeps neither the conversation nor the raw answer. The ID card or passport scan happens on the device: the document photo is sent nowhere. An agency can turn AI off in Settings.

where.title: Where is the data?
where.body: In a database hosted by Supabase, ({region}), with encrypted connections. Each agency only sees its own data: this separation is enforced by the database itself.

keep.title: How long?
keep.body: As long as the agency uses Parcolia. The agency can anonymize a client at any time, or all clients without a rental for several years (Settings > Data). If the agency is deleted, all its data and files are erased. Encrypted backups are kept for 30 days.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: Anyone can ask to access, correct or delete their data, and object to its processing for a legitimate reason. An agency's clients: contact the agency, which can export or anonymize your data from Parcolia. Agency members or any other request: write to {contact}. You can also contact the CNDP (www.cndp.ma).

security.title: Security
security.body: Passwords never stored in clear, optional two-step login, limited login attempts, separate admin / staff access, activity log, security headers, encrypted daily backups.
